title: Section-normalized ordinary and derived system operation models
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l. On the strict sequence-site categories of [def-strict-coefficient-system-operation-data], there exist Operations o and Compositors c, together with OpenComparisons for o,c and a CanonicalBridge for o [def-strict-coefficient-system-realization-data]. These retain every specified section, representative, unit/counit and evaluation normalization in those records. No proper/open pasting structure and no tensor/composition equation is part of this assertion.

source.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence; expanded strict-system realization argument, as recorded in lem-sf-integral-canonical-ambient-models.

proof.text: Use coefficientMap uniqueness to identify the structural sequence-ring maps. Mathlib pushforwardCongr then gives ordinaryBridge, literally identity on all sections. This proves CanonicalBridge for any Operations.

The existing derivedImage_exists helper constructs the universal right-derived direct image with its normalized adjunction. Localization.liftNatIso identifies its exact inverse with the published pull, and its factor equation follows from liftNatTrans_app. The ordinary exact open extension is the existing semilinear extension, with right adjoint transported through ordinaryBridge and leftAdjointUniq. Apply the direct evaluation theorem and invert the canonical open evaluation mate. These fill Operations without a holed definition.

Whisker ordinaryBridge into the existing section-normalized ordinary pushComp and back. Its sections formula is the existing pushComp formula since every bridge component is identity on underlying sections. Define ordinaryPull by leftAdjointCompIso and prove the conjugate equation by conjugateEquiv_leftAdjointCompIso_inv. Localize ordinaryPull and compose with mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. The two mapDerivedCategory factor lemmas give pullComp_model. This explicitly constructs Compositors.

Apply the separate open-support comparison result to the constructed Operations and Compositors, and package it with the explicit identity-on-sections CanonicalBridge. The upper existential proof has no remaining sorry.

lean.statement:
theorem integralSystemOperationModels :
    ∃ (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o),
      Nonempty (OpenComparisons l E o c) ∧ Nonempty (CanonicalBridge l E o)
